mapper.select: /* 마케팅 프로젝트 단건 조회 marketing.selectMarketingProject */ SELECT p.MKT_PROJECT_ID AS MARKETING_PROJECT_ID , p.PROJECT_NM AS PROJECT_NM , p.ORG_NM AS ORG_NM , p.PROJECT_OVERVIEW AS PROJECT_OVERVIEW , DATE_FORMAT(p.DUE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS DUE_DT , p.STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD , cd.CODE_NM AS STATUS_NM , CAST(p.PROJECT_CONFIG_JSON AS CHAR) AS PROJECT_CONFIG_JSON , p.CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID , DATE_FORMAT(p.CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT , p.MODIFY_USER_ID AS MODIFY_USER_ID , DATE_FORMAT(p.MODIFY_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS MODIFY_DT FROM TB_MKT_PROJECT p LEFT JOIN TB_CODE cd ON cd.CODE_GRP_ID = 'PT000002' AND cd.CODE_ID = p.STATUS_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND p.MKT_PROJECT_ID = #{marketingProjectId}
mapper.update: /* 마감일 경과 프로젝트 작성중→검수중 일괄 전환 marketing.advanceOverdueProjectsToReview */ UPDATE TB_MKT_PROJECT SET STATUS_CD = '002' , MODIFY_DT = NOW() WHERE STATUS_CD = '001' AND DUE_DT IS NOT NULL AND DUE_DT < CURDATE()
mapper.select: /* 마케팅 파일 목록 조회 marketing.selectMarketingFileList */ SELECT f.MKT_FILE_ID AS MARKETING_FILE_ID , f.MKT_PROJECT_ID AS MARKETING_PROJECT_ID , f.FILE_PATH AS FILE_PATH , f.FILE_NM AS FILE_NM , f.FILE_SIZE AS FILE_SIZE , f.FILE_TYPE AS FILE_TYPE , f.CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID , DATE_FORMAT(f.CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT FROM TB_MKT_FILE f WHERE 1 = 1 AND f.MKT_PROJECT_ID = #{marketingProjectId} ORDER BY f.CREATE_DT DESC

/* 마케팅 파일 단건 조회 marketing.selectMarketingFileById */ SELECT f.MKT_FILE_ID AS MARKETING_FILE_ID , f.MKT_PROJECT_ID AS MARKETING_PROJECT_ID , f.FILE_PATH AS FILE_PATH , f.FILE_NM AS FILE_NM , f.FILE_SIZE AS FILE_SIZE , f.FILE_TYPE AS FILE_TYPE , f.CREATE_USER_ID AS CREATE_USER_ID , DATE_FORMAT(f.CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT FROM TB_MKT_FILE f WHERE f.MKT_FILE_ID = #{marketingFileId}
mapper.delete: /* 프로젝트 소속 첨부파일 전체 삭제 marketing.deleteMarketingFilesByProject */ DELETE FROM TB_MKT_FILE WHERE MKT_PROJECT_ID = #{marketingProjectId}
mapper.select: /* 마케팅 콘텐츠 단건 조회 marketing.selectMarketing */ SELECT m.MKT_ID AS MKT_ID , m.MKT_PROJECT_ID AS MARKETING_PROJECT_ID , m.AGENT_ID AS AGENT_ID , m.TITLE AS TITLE , m.OUTPUT_MODE AS OUTPUT_MODE , m.STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD , m.CONTENT_TYPE AS CONTENT_TYPE , m.REQUEST_JSON AS REQUEST_JSON , DATE_FORMAT(m.PUBLISH_SCHEDULED_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS PUBLISH_SCHEDULED_DT , m.PUBLISHED_YN AS PUBLISHED_YN , u.USER_NM AS CREATE_USER_NM , DATE_FORMAT(m.CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT FROM TB_MKT m LEFT JOIN TB_USER u ON u.USER_ID = m.CREATE_USER_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND m.MKT_ID = #{mktId}
mapper.delete: /* 마케팅 콘텐츠 삭제 marketing.deleteMarketing */ DELETE FROM TB_MKT WHERE MKT_ID = #{mktId}
/* 프로젝트 소속 콘텐츠 전체 삭제 marketing.deleteMarketingByProject */ DELETE FROM TB_MKT WHERE MKT_PROJECT_ID = #{marketingProjectId}
mapper.select: /* 마케팅 콘텐츠 시안 목록 조회 marketing.selectMarketingContents */ SELECT c.MKT_CONTENT_ID AS MKT_CONTENT_ID , c.CONTENT_NO AS CONTENT_NO , c.RECOMMEND_YN AS RECOMMEND_YN , c.CONTENT_LABEL AS CONTENT_LABEL , c.TEXT_CONTENT AS TEXT_CONTENT , c.IMAGE_FILE AS IMAGE_FILE , c.MODIFY_USER_ID AS MODIFY_USER_ID , CASE WHEN c.PREV_TEXT_CONTENT IS NOT NULL OR c.PREV_IMAGE_FILE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS HAS_PREVIOUS_YN FROM TB_MKT_CONTENT c WHERE 1 = 1 AND c.MKT_ID = #{mktId} ORDER BY c.CONTENT_NO

/* 마케팅 콘텐츠 시안 단건 조회 marketing.selectMarketingContent */ SELECT c.MKT_CONTENT_ID AS MKT_CONTENT_ID , c.CONTENT_NO AS CONTENT_NO , c.TEXT_CONTENT AS TEXT_CONTENT , c.IMAGE_FILE AS IMAGE_FILE FROM TB_MKT_CONTENT c WHERE 1 = 1 AND c.MKT_ID = #{mktId} AND c.CONTENT_NO = #{contentNo} LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: /* 마케팅 콘텐츠 시안 전체 삭제 marketing.deleteMarketingContents */ DELETE FROM TB_MKT_CONTENT WHERE MKT_ID = #{mktId}
